summary: No installer-harm signals identified in chain-manager@1.0.9
details: Analysis of chain-manager@1.0.9 produced no a static rule matches and no traced findings of exfiltration, install-time remote code execution, credential harvesting, silent-relay, backdoor, or self-propagation behavior. No attacker-controlled network destinations, no lifecycle-script droppers, and no reads of installer-side secret paths were observed in the scanned files.
